name: limit-pace
description: Band above the prompt showing plan usage against an even pace through the weekly and 5-hour windows

week.title: Week
week.description: When to show the weekly window: always, only when close to or ahead of an even pace (yellow or red), or never

session.title: Session
session.description: When to show the 5-hour window: always, only when close to or ahead of an even pace (yellow or red), or never

threshold.title: Close within, %
threshold.description: How far below an even pace usage turns yellow and counts as close; 0 = only exactly on pace

format.title: Figures
format.description: Used share over the even-pace share (41% / 29%), or how far usage runs from that pace (+12%)

ring.title: Usage ring
ring.description: Where each window's usage ring goes, with a tick at an even pace (desktop only)

show_reset.title: Show time to reset
show_reset.description: Show the time left until each window resets, in parentheses after the figures

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Mark between the weekly and the session figures
